items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Well, one night there, who walks in but Vincent Lopez,

ctx.x: So we took the job, and we went up there with the band and played and had a good time, got very well acquainted with the Chinese food and it was a lot of writing, you have to keep up with the tunes and the band got, you know, what it's got to get better, with all that playing. It got pretty good.
Well, one night there, who walks in but Vincent Lopez,

and he comes in with the manager or some such thing and listens to the band, likes the band and he says, 'They're going to open up a hotel here. Hotel Syracuse. How would you like the job?' He said, 'All we'll do is open it. I'll be there the first night,' and he said, 'You can have the job.' He said, 'You can go to school up here in Syracuse.'
